_comment: DIAG fact sheet for the wave-5 window-loss instrument (scripts/windowloss-20261022.js). Re-analysis ONLY: every fact below is read from the landed corpora, never simulated. Breaking-death detail (RERUN level, scholar status, mantle chain) comes from the authoritative DIAG narrative in evidence/2026-10-22/sim-vetwindow.md (PHASE 1), which itself was traced from evidence/2026-10-22/diag-vetwindow.json (daily readiness census + veteran death rows + Game.say capture). The say-capture backing files lived in /tmp and are gone; the .md narrative is the surviving record — cited per row.

attribution_rule.description: Deterministic loss-channel rule for the window-BREAKING death (the death on the first day the veterans count dropped below 2).
precedence: rerun-escalation: the breaking fight carried RERUN-overtime scaling at level >= 3 (+75% HP / +36% dmg and up) — the clock, not the exposure, is the killer.
mantle-succession: the deceased was the mantle-holding scholar leading the party (the mantle-promotion chain put them in the fight) and the breaking fight's RERUN level was < 3.
veterans: any other veteran death (plain window attrition in unscaled fights).
armor/other: reserved for windows that end with veterans intact (blocker = loss channel) or non-combat loss.
attribution_rule.rerun_scale_per_level: +25% HP / +12% dmg per overtime level (task brief; observed ~d112 x1, ~d119 x2, ~d126 x3)

provenance.window_definition: maximal contiguous run of days with veterans>=2 (2 living roster members with wave-4+ kills in state.waveKillLog) while unlockedWave()<5
